title: Tag Details Object
description: Schema for validating the Tag Details column JSON object structure in FOCUS datasets

^x_[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$.description: Custom data generator-defined top-level properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format

^(?!x_[A-Z]).+$.description: Objects containing information about a tag scheme (including 'Default') in the Tags column

tagScheme.description: An object containing information about a specific tag scheme, including its tags and eligible untagged sources.

^x_[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$.description: Custom data generator-defined properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format

UntaggedSources.description: A list of sources which support this tag scheme that had no tags applied

^x_[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$.description: Custom data generator-defined properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format

tagKeyObject.description: An object containing the properties of a finalized tag as well as other tag sources where this key was present.

TagSource.description: The type of tag source where the tag key is present. Can be null if only present on an ancestor.

TagSourceId.description: The identifier of the tag source where the tag key is present. Can be null if only present on an ancestor.

TagValue.description: The finalized tag value. Can be null, indicating it doesn't appear in the Tags column.

AncestorTaggedSources.description: An object containing all tag sources where the tag key was present which did not result in the finalized tag.

^x_[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$.description: Custom data generator-defined properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format
Custom data generator-defined properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format

ancestorTag.description: An object containing the properties of a tag present in an ancestor tag source.

TagSourceId.description: The identifier of the tag source where the tag key is present.

TagValue.description: The tag value from an ancestor source.

^x_[A-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*$.description: Custom data generator-defined properties prefixed with x_ in PascalCase format
